1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based controller arranged to receive input signals and execute control algorithms to modulate valve operation__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __a plurality of first valves and a plurality of second valves, wherein the first and second valves are independently controllable__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, the larger and smaller valves being configured for different operational pressure ranges__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the __at least one smaller valve is arranged to operate at high speed and to provide fine pressure modulation__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __at least one of the first valves and at least one of the second valves are driven by binary actuators, and wherein the control means is arranged to pulse the binary actuators at variable frequencies to achieve proportional control of brake pressure__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from __a wheel speed sensor, an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and a vehicle acceleration sensor__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and __to dynamically adjust braking force based on real-time sensor feedback and stored reference data__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __and wherein the control means is further arranged to implement anti-lock braking functionality by modulating valve operation to prevent wheel lockup__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __at least one air braking unit according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; a central compressed air storage tank; and a system controller in communication with the control means of each air braking unit to coordinate braking across multiple wheels__.
